recent_articles.title: Karnataka Chief Minister DK Shivakumar Takes Oath, G Parameshwara Is His Deputy
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **DK Shivakumar**, a prominent figure in the **Congress**, took oath as the Chief Minister of Karnataka, ending a two-year political tussle. His cabinet of 13 ministers includes his predecessor's son, **Yathindra Siddaramaiah**.  G Parameshwara was appointed Deputy Chief Minister, balancing social factions within the party. The event saw participation from Congress leaders like **Rahul Gandhi**, **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra**, and other state chief ministers. Shivakumar expressed gratitude to the **Gandhi family** for their support in his political journey.

recent_articles.title: Meeting between Zameer Ahmed Khan and D.K. Suresh raises eyebrows in Karnataka - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **B.Z. Zameer Ahmed Khan** met with former **MP D.K. Suresh** in a closed-door meeting that sparked speculation about political fallout from an audio clip purportedly featuring him discussing sabotage of the Davangere South bypoll election chances.  Congress leaders from Davangere have called for action against **Khan**, citing the audio as evidence of anti-party activities, while **Shamanur**, the winning Congress candidate, has urged party leadership to verify the clip's authenticity.

recent_articles.title: Amid War Of Words With Revanth Reddy, Pawan Kalyan's Party's Big Move
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pawan Kalyan**, chief of the **Jana Sena Party**, announced his party's intention to contest the upcoming Telangana assembly elections. He also questioned a Congress leader's admiration for Pakistan and urged **Rahul Gandhi** and **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra** to respond to his allegations.  Kalyan emphasized his long-standing support for Telangana culture and stated that Jana Sena is not opposed to the state's existence, but rather its formation process.

recent_articles.title: Schools must prepare children for knowledge-driven future: Minister - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Agriculture Minister T. Siddique** inaugurated the Wayanad district-level ‘Pravesanotsavam’ (school reopening festival) at Government Higher Secondary School, Perikkalloor, emphasizing the need to transform education into a nurturing experience for children in the knowledge-driven world. He stressed the importance of fostering joy and confidence in students while ensuring their safety from negative influences.  **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra**, MP, is leading efforts to construct the Bairakuppa bridge, aiming to minimize its impact on the forest ecosystem, according to **Agriculture Minister T. Siddique**.

recent_articles.title: ‘I never studied for number,’: Meet Kabeer Chhillar, AIR 2 in JEE Advanced 2026
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kabeer Chhillar**, an IIT Roorkee graduate, secured the second-highest rank in the JEE Advanced 2026 exam with a score of 329 out of 360.  He achieved this despite not focusing on the ranking and instead prioritizing understanding concepts. **Chhillar**'s success was attributed to his disciplined study habits, strong mental fortitude, and passion for learning. He plans to pursue a Computer Science degree at IIT Bombay and potentially further studies at MIT.

recent_articles.title: ‘I never studied for number,’: Meet Kabeer Chhillar, AIR 2 in JEE Advanced 2026
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kabeer Chhillar**, from the IIT Delhi zone, secured the second-highest rank in the JEE Advanced 2026 results with an AIR of 2.  He scored 329 out of 360 marks, just one mark behind the top scorer, **Shubham Kumar**.  **Chhillar's** father, a **IIT Kharagpur** alumnus, emphasized that his son focused on understanding concepts rather than chasing rankings.  The young student, who has represented Haryana in soccer and enjoys music, plans to pursue CSE at **IIT Bombay** and further studies at the **Massachusetts Institute of Technology**.

recent_articles.title: Ramachandra Guha Says Gandhi Family Actions Helped Modi Consolidate Power | OdishaBytes
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ramachandra Guha**, a historian, argues that the **Gandhi family** and **Congress** insiders have indirectly aided Prime Minister **Narendra Modi**'s power consolidation after the 2024 general election.  Guha criticizes Rahul Gandhi's Bharat Jodo Yatra for enhancing his credibility but frittering it away by reasserting the Congress as a family firm. He also points to the party's declining footprint in state assemblies and suggests that Rahul remains an instrument of his mother's will, hindering a successful pushback against the BJP. Guha warns against elevating **Priyanka Gandhi** as an alternative, calling her a "entitled dynast," and criticizes dynastic promotions within the Congress, arguing they have been detrimental to the party's electoral prospects. He acknowledges the BJP's dominance under Modi but suggests that the Gandhis have aided his consolidation.

recent_articles.title: Rahul Gandhi as PM | Modi’s enablers - The Gandhi family and the BJP’s dominance - Telegraph India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A recent article criticizes the leadership of **Rahul Gandhi** and his sister, **Priyanka Gandhi**, within the **Congress Party**.  The author argues that despite the party's gains in the 2024 general elections, their lack of discipline, gravitas, and a clear vision for governance have hindered their progress. The author suggests that the Congress has lost ground to the **Bharatiya Janata Party** in many states, while highlighting the need for a new leader who can inspire voters and address the public's concerns about economic mismanagement and rising inequality.  The article also criticizes the reliance on dynastic politics within the party, comparing it to similar situations in other countries like Hungary where a fresh face emerged as an effective opposition leader.

recent_articles.title: Karnataka CM News: Why Siddaramaiah's dethroning might hit Rahul Gandhi the worst - Karnataka News | India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Congress** high command brokered a transition formula in Karnataka, asking **Siddaramaiah** to resign as Chief Minister. This move has sparked protests and discontent among supporters of the veteran OBC leader, who is viewed as a strong mass leader in the state. The decision to remove **Siddaramaiah**, who had built the party organizationally over two decades, could potentially hurt **Rahul Gandhi's** political image, particularly his efforts to consolidate support for Dalits, minorities, and backward-class voters.  The move has also been criticized as unfair to a prominent leader within the party, raising concerns about potential backlash in future elections.

recent_articles.title: MLA demands immediate launch of phase II seawall construction in Chellanam - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mohammed Shiyas**, MLA, urged the immediate commencement of the second phase of construction for a seawall along Chellanam's unprotected coastline. The meeting at the district collectorate focused on removing obstacles to the project, with **District Collector G. Priyanka** stating that geobags are being deployed to prevent sea incursion.  The Chellanam-Kochi Janakeeya Vedhi escalated its protest demanding immediate construction from Puthenthode, while technical sanction for the project remains pending. The second phase of the project, inaugurated by former Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan in March 2026, aims to protect the coastline between Chellanam and Fort Kochi.

recent_articles.title: 24x7 control rooms for disaster management to be set up in Ernakulam - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **District Collector G. Priyanka** announced the activation of **Taluk Emergency Operation Centres (TEOCs)** by May 20th to prepare for the monsoon season. The district has received a ₹5 crore disaster relief fund from the **State Disaster Management Authority (SDMA)** and additional funds for desilting rivers, cleaning canals, and installing geobags along the Chellanam coast.  Local bodies have been tasked with identifying potential relief camps and furnishing equipment for emergency response.

recent_articles.title: Free vaccination for cervical cancer until May 31 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **District Collector G. Priyanka** announced the final phase of the HPV vaccination campaign against cervical cancer in the district, urging all eligible girls to receive the vaccine before May 31, 2026.  The campaign aims to vaccinate a total of 22,358 girls aged 14 and under, with only 34% currently vaccinated as of the current date. The vaccination facility will cease operation after this deadline.

recent_articles.title: AICC begins consultations with Kerala leaders in New Delhi to decide on Congress’ CM candidate - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, **Sonia Gandhi**, and **Mallikarjun Kharge** met with top Kerala leaders in New Delhi on Tuesday to discuss the selection of a Chief Minister nominee for the state. The high command is seeking bipartisan support from former KPCC presidents, Congress MLAs-elect, and other key figures to restore organizational stability after the party's recent victory.  The meeting considered several potential candidates, including **K.C. Venugopal**, **V.D. Satheesan**, **Ramesh Chennithala**, and **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra**.  **K. Muraleedharan**, a KPCC insider, stated that the high command would consider popular opinion in addition to legislative party numbers when making their decision.

recent_articles.title: Counting of votes to be held at three centres in Ernakulam - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **District Collector G. Counting will begin at 8 a.m., with postal ballots being counted first followed by EVM votes. Initial trends are expected around 10 a.m.

recent_articles.title: Rahul Gandhi cites Gujarat BJP chief’s ‘indecent remarks’ against Geniben Thakor - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha, criticized **the BJP** after its Gujarat unit president made an offensive remark about Congress MP Geniben Thakor.  Gandhi accused the party of having a "distorted mindset" and promoting an "anti-women" ideology, stating that the BJP's actions contradict their claims of women empowerment. **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra**, Congress general secretary, also condemned the incident, supporting **Geniben Thakor** and highlighting the hypocrisy of the BJP's "Nari Vandana" campaign.

recent_articles.title: Bail order reminder that personal liberty can’t be sacrificed for political vendetta: Pawan Khera - The Hindu

The Congress hailed the decision as a victory for the rule of law, urging **Sarma** to reconsider his language and apologize.

recent_articles.title: Mukunda Reddy takes charge as I&PR Special Commissioner - The Hindu

The reshuffle also saw several collectors being transferred to different districts.

recent_articles.title: ‘Victim is Dalit, poor every time’: Rahul Gandhi demands probe into Ghazipur rape-murder - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra**, and the **Congress party** are demanding a high-level investigation into the alleged rape and murder of a girl from the Vishwakarma community in Uttar Pradesh's Ghazipur district. **Gandhi** criticized the government for its inaction and demanded immediate justice, protection for the victim's family, and action against police officers involved.  He also questioned Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** and Chief Minister **Yogi Adityanath**, asking why their rule has made daughters unsafe.

recent_articles.title: Centre's conspiracy to change federal structure defeated; victory of Opposition unity, says Priyanka - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra**, **Congress** general secretary, declared the defeat of the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill to implement women's reservation as a victory for democracy and opposition unity. She accused the **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and **Home Minister Amit Shah** of attempting to manipulate the women's reservation law for political gain by linking it with delimitation plans. The bill, which aimed to increase Lok Sabha seats and state assembly representation through 33% reservation for women, failed to secure a two-thirds majority in the Lower House.

recent_articles.title: Chaturvedi’s grumbling over defeat of Women’s Bill’ flies in the face of her party’s stand - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Shiv Sena UBT** leader Priyanka Chaturvedi criticized the defeat of the Women’s Reservation Bill in the Lok Sabha, expressing her opposition to its inclusion with the Delimitation Bill. **Sanjay Raut**, a Shiv Sena UBT MP, stated that the party opposed the bill because it was presented as a means for the BJP to advance their own agenda. Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis condemned the opposition's actions, calling them hypocritical and stating that they prioritized politics over progress.

recent_articles.title: India fails to pass bill to boost women’s representation after delimitation row | India | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Indian** government failed to pass a bill increasing female representation in parliament after accusations of using it as a cover for electoral map redrawing. The bill, requiring a two-thirds majority, was opposed by the opposition who argued it was an attempt to manipulate the electoral process and unfairly benefit certain states.  This failure marks the first time in 12 years that a constitutional amendment proposed by **Narendra Modi’s Bharatiya Janata party (BJP)** government failed to pass parliament.

recent_articles.title: Noida workers’ protests: Two RJD spokespersons booked for sharing ‘misleading’ video, inciting tension - The Hindu

The **Uttar Pardesh Police** have registered an FIR against them and the X handle @ItsKtyni, alleging they spread rumors during the protests.

recent_articles.title: Rahul Gandhi, other Congress leaders to campaign in T.N. soon - The Hindu

recent_articles.rephrased_article: **All India Congress Committee (AICC)** in-charge for Tamil Nadu and Puducherry, **Girish Chodankar**, announced that **Rahul Gandhi** and **Priyanka Gandhi** will campaign in the state soon. recent_articles.title: Congress discusses women’s reservation law and delimitation; Kharge to meet other Opposition leaders for joint strategy - The Hindu

The party plans to formulate a joint strategy for the upcoming special session of Parliament, aiming to implement the women's reservation law by 2029 and increase the strength of the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies by 50%.  **Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge**, **Sonia Gandhi**, and **Rahul Gandhi** expressed concerns about the proposed changes, emphasizing the need for wider consultation on delimitation. The party also criticized the government's move to implement a predetermined number of seats for women, arguing that it undermines proportional representation for other marginalized groups.

recent_articles.title: Delhi HC rejects Sanjay Bhandari's plea against 'fugitive offender' tag - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Delhi High Court** upheld a trial court's order declaring **Sanjay Bhandari**, a U.K.-based arms consultant, a "fugitive economic offender" in connection with a money laundering case.  **Bhandari** fled to London in 2016 after an I-T department raid and the **Enforcement Directorate** (ED) has been pursuing charges against him since 2020. The court rejected his legal team's argument that his stay in the U.K. is not illegal, stating that he cannot escape prosecution for violating Indian laws.

recent_articles.title: Mallikarjun Kharge expresses regret over 'illiterate' remark, says he has highest of respect for Gujaratis - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge** issued a statement expressing regret for his controversial remarks about the people of Gujarat during an election speech in Kerala. He clarified that he never intended to offend the people of Gujarat and maintains respect for them. The **BJP** demanded an apology from **Kharge**, accusing him of making "shameless, demeaning and utterly despicable" statements.

recent_articles.title: Assam Assembly election 2026: Curtains down on high-voltage campaign - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Assam Assembly elections concluded on April 7, with voters casting their ballots for the state's 126 seats. **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, and other BJP leaders campaigned against the opposition Congress, accusing it of promoting infiltrators and failing to address development issues. The Congress countered by highlighting corruption allegations against the ruling party and promising justice for singer Zubeen Garg if elected. Prominent candidates include Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma, Gaurav Gogoi (Congress), Badruddin Ajmal (AIUDF), and Debabrata Saikia (opposition).  The elections will be held in a single phase on April 9th.

recent_articles.title: Kerala Assembly Elections 2026: Close contest likely across Wayanad’s three constituencies - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: As Wayanad prepares for the April 9 Assembly elections, local issues are expected to dominate the campaign. **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra**, **Congress** general secretary and representative of the Wayanad Lok Sabha segment, is seeking re-election in a district where voters prioritize local candidates and concerns. The aftermath of the 2024 Mundakkai–Chooralmala landslides has become a key issue in Kalpetta, while tribal land rights and welfare remain central to the contests in Mananthavady and Sulthan Bathery.  The UDF is banking on its traditional support base and anti-incumbency sentiment, while the LDF emphasizes governance, welfare delivery, and crisis response. The BJP is attempting to expand its presence.

recent_articles.title: PM’s policies pushing country deeper into crisis, says Priyanka - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra**, Congress leader, criticized **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and **Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma** for what she called "double-slavery" governance in Assam. She accused them of prioritizing personal gain over the well-being of the people and threatened to withhold or cancel beneficiary schemes if they did not attend rallies.  Vadra also promised justice for late singer Zubeen Garg, who died in Singapore, and vowed a Congress government would deliver within its first 100 days. The single-phase election will be held on April 9th with counting scheduled for May 4th.

recent_articles.title: Oil slides 4% to below $100/bbl as Middle East uncertainty keeps markets on edge - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Brent** and **U.S. WTI** crude oil prices fell on Wednesday, driven by uncertainty surrounding the Middle East conflict's resolution.  The decline followed earlier gains as investors locked in profits amid reports that Iran's president might end the war. While a swift de-escalation could ease supply constraints, analysts warn that damage to oil infrastructure and normalization of shipping routes will take time. **OPEC** output dropped significantly due to the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, while **U.S.** crude oil production also fell sharply in January following a severe winter storm.

recent_articles.title: Kerala election 2026: Polls heat up as major fronts step up campaigns and identity politics takes centrestage - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: With the Kerala Assembly polls approaching, **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Rahul Gandhi**, and **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra** are among the high-profile figures campaigning. The election has become increasingly polarized with accusations of backroom deals and communal overtures from groups like the SDPI and JIH.  The ruling **CPI(M)-led Left Democratic Front (LDF)** is highlighting a decade of development, while the **United Democratic Front (UDF)** faces internal strife over its leadership and attempts to revive the Sabarimala gold theft scandal. The BJP seeks to expand its vote share into actual seats, but faces challenges from the FCRA issue with the Christian electorate.

recent_articles.title: Bengali actor Rahul Arunoday Banerjee drowns in sea - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Arunoday Banerjee**, a popular Bengali actor, died on Sunday (March 29, 2026) after drowning at Talsari beach in Odisha. The actor was 43 and left behind his wife **Priyanka Sarkar** and their son.  **Mamata Banerjee**, the West Bengal Chief Minister, expressed her condolences, calling him a "distinguished" and "popular" actor.  A case of unnatural death has been registered in Digha police station.

recent_articles.title: Crisis management committee formed in Ernakulam to look into cooking gas supply - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **District Collector G. Priyanka** has formed a crisis management committee in Ernakulam district to address the ongoing cooking gas distribution issues. The committee, chaired by **Priyanka**,  reviewed the situation and determined that while domestic cylinder supply is smooth, commercial cylinder supply has been restricted.  The committee also announced priority for commercial cylinder distribution to specific institutions and the deployment of nine inspection squads to prevent black marketing.

recent_articles.title: Transgender bill passed by voice vote in Lok Sabha - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Lok Sabha** passed the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Amendment Bill, 2026, by voice vote. The bill aims to redefine "transgender person" based on biological or physiological markers and socio-cultural identities, while opposition parties like the Congress, DMK, and SP argued that it violates basic human rights and undermines self-determination.  The government defended the bill as necessary for providing safety and benefits to the transgender community.

recent_articles.title: Govt revs up consultations on early implementation of Women’s Reservation Act - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Narendra Modi** government announced plans to amend the Women’s Reservation Act, 2023 to implement its provisions for the 2029 Lok Sabha election. The amendment will reserve one-third of seats in Parliament and State Assemblies for women based on the 2011 Census data.  The **Union Home Minister Amit Shah** met with leaders from various Opposition parties including the Nationalist Congress Party, YSR Congress Party, All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen, and Shiv Sena (UBT) to discuss the proposed amendments. The government aims to introduce these amendments in Parliament during the ongoing Budget Session or a Special Session later this year.

recent_articles.title: Revanth Reddy is building his own band of loyalists - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Revanth Reddy**, the Chief Minister of Telangana, is consolidating his power within both the government and the state Congress party. He has appointed several young, recently joined Congress members to key positions, including Assembly and Legislative Council Whips.  This move signals a clear intention to shape the party's future leadership with his own loyalists. While a coordination committee was formed to bridge the gap between the government and the party, **Revanth Reddy**’s recent actions suggest he is determined to maintain control within the party structure.

recent_articles.title: Banned flex boards seized in Kochi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **District Collector G. Priyanka** ordered a crackdown on illegal flex boards used in election campaigning, seizing 25 kg of prohibited materials during inspections at printing establishments within the **Kochi Corporation**.  A fine of ₹25,000 was imposed on one establishment found to be violating the green protocol. The District Enforcement Squad will continue to enforce these rules and take action against violators throughout the election period.

recent_articles.title: Polling booths in Ernakulam set to go ‘viral’ with green initiatives - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **District Administration** of Ernakulam, along with the **Suchitwa Mission** and **Haritha Keralam Mission**, are launching a campaign to make elections greener.  People can donate used clothes at designated collection centers to create mobile deposit facilities outside polling stations. These items will be repurposed from donated clothing, made entirely of pure cotton cloth, and will hold up to 9-12 phones. Additionally, waste generated after the polls will be used to create souvenirs such as pen stands, paperweights, lanterns, and pots.

recent_articles.title: Kerala Assembly polls: Gandhi siblings recast Wayanad politics, but local fault lines persist - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The 2021 Kerala Assembly election saw the **Gandhi** siblings, Rahul and Priyanka, secure victories in Wayanad.  While Rahul Gandhi won the Lok Sabha seat with a significant margin in both 2019 and 2024, his sister Priyanka's victory in a byelection further solidified the family's influence. The election results were influenced by regional issues such as welfare schemes, tribal development, and human-wildlife conflict.  The **LDF** retained Mananthavady while the **UDF** capitalized on agrarian distress to win Kalpetta and Sulthan Bathery.

recent_articles.title: Brent crude spikes above $115/bbl after attacks on Mideast energy assets multiply - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Brent** and **U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI)** crude oil prices surged on Wednesday, driven by renewed attacks on Middle Eastern energy facilities and concerns about potential supply disruptions.  **QatarEnergy** reported extensive damage to its Ras Laffan energy hub after Iranian missile strikes. **Saudi Arabia** intercepted and destroyed ballistic missiles aimed at Riyadh and a drone attack targeted a gas facility. **Kuwait Petroleum Corporation** also reported an operational unit at its Mina al-Ahmadi refinery was hit by a drone, igniting a limited fire.  The **Federal Reserve** held interest rates steady on Wednesday, citing economic concerns related to the ongoing conflict between Israel and Iran.

recent_articles.title: Assam Congress weighs MP’s flight to BJP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pradyut Bordoloi**, a Congress MP from Assam, resigned and joined the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** in New Delhi on Wednesday.  He was accompanied by **Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma** and **State BJP president Dilip Saikia**.  Congress leader **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra** expressed disappointment over Bordoloi's resignation, while **Jitendra Singh**, an AICC secretary in charge of Assam, suggested that the MP had been planning to join the BJP for a long time.  The Congress is facing internal dissent as several leaders are contemplating leaving the party ahead of the upcoming elections.
